exact: Extended Homberger, 1,000 customers per instance. 120 instances from 60 A/B parents.
24 development and 96 holdout instances (48 holdout parents). 8,606 routes / 2,891 exposed overall. Holdout: 6,864 / 2,321.
Fixed customers and order, capacity Q = 700, consumption h = 1. Euclidean travel, linear station-specific charging, native units.
Independent synthetic lognormal waits per visit. 4 reused station attribute tables. Station hours disabled.
95% route target. Maximum 64 distinct trials, 131,072 search draws and 5 s cooperative guard. Trials include the original plan.
512 common draws for full stochastic scores, with a 128-draw STaR prefix. Up to 3 nearby eligible stations per considered gap.
10,000 independent validation draws per plan, paired across methods. One-sided 95% Wilson attainment. 9,999 family-stratified parent bootstrap resamples.
